cohort: Babies delivered at Omdurman Maternity Hospital, Sudan in August 2016, excluding stillbirths, multiple births, and those with insufficient data; 175 babies with low birth weight and 175 matched controls with normal birth weight.
finding: Hypertensive disorders in pregnancy were independently associated with a nearly three-fold increased risk of low birth weight.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (<2500g) and normal birth weight (>=2500g)
